instruction: A solar power station in orbit: vast wings of photovoltaic panels in precise arrays, a central truss spine with a habitat module, a maintenance robot crawling along a rail, relay dishes, glinting sun flare on the panels, tether lines, the blue limb of Earth with cloud swirls below, a drifting cargo pod, and a dense starfield behind.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Orbital Solar Farm. A solar power station in orbit: vast wings of photovoltaic panels in precise arrays, a central truss spine with a habitat module, a maintenance robot crawling along a rail, relay dishes, glinting sun flare on the panels, tether lines, the blue limb of Earth with cloud swirls below, a drifting cargo pod, and a dense starfield behind. Style: hard sci-fi. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
